_doc: Protection code: bad tool-call handling written by hand. Only the OpenaiSDK arm has any in its core lines: byLLM, LangGraph's ToolNode and NOOA's CodeAct report unknown tools and bad arguments back to the model inside the framework. The repeat-call guard sits in the shared task environment (adapter), so it is not listed. Kept in every arm: the step budget (MAX_STEPS) and the normal stop condition.
